headline: Foreign Capital Outflows on Ho Chi Minh Bourse Exceed $4.9 Billion Record
summary: Foreign investors net sold VND 127 trillion ($4.9 billion) worth of stocks on the Ho Chi Minh City exchange this year, breaking the record high set in 2025.
why: Foreign institutional flows on the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange are a key driver of market liquidity and valuation for Vietnamese equities.

impacts.name: VN-Index
impacts.why: Record net foreign selling reduces institutional demand for Vietnamese equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent foreign capital net selling of VND 127 trillion weighed on Vietnamese equity markets.
